entities.name: Sidar Kondo
entities.description: Head of a Jamuraan warclan during the Mirage War, slain by his own son Vuel.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Raised by Kondo as his son; saved Vuel at the last moment of his trial.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem and guardian of Gerrard, given to Kondo's charge.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: Kondo's true son, crippled by poisoned warpaint, exiled, who later attacked the clan and slew Kondo.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: Poisoned the ceremonial warpaint used on Vuel.

entities.name: Gerrard's Legacy
entities.description: Artifact parts of which Vuel stole.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War during which Kondo headed the clan.

events.summary: Kondo is given charge of Gerrard Capashen and his guardian Karn and raises Gerrard as his son.
events.quote: Kondo raised Gerrard as his son, placing him alongside his true son Vuel in the hierarchy of the clan

events.summary: Starke il-Vec poisons Vuel's ceremonial warpaint; Vuel is crippled and fails his trial, saved by Gerrard.
events.quote: Vuel was crippled when Starke il -Vec poisoned the ceremonial warpaint used on Vuel for the ritual

events.summary: Exiled Vuel steals parts of Gerrard's Legacy and raises a mercenary army to attack the Kondo clan.
events.quote: Vuel stole parts of Gerrard's Legacy , amassing an army of mercenaries

events.summary: In the attack, Kondo is slain by his own son.
events.quote: Kondo was slain by his own son

relations.quote: Kondo was slain by his own son
Sidar Kondo was head of a Jamuraan warclan during the Mirage War
